properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior...
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
properties.longDescription: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat. The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms. This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee.

properties.description: Stunning four bedroom detached house in a prime location with modern finishes throughout.
properties.longDescription: This exceptional four bedroom detached family home offers spacious accommodation arranged over two floors. The ground floor features a grand entrance hall, a large living room with bay window, separate dining room, modern fitted kitchen/breakfast room with integrated appliances, and a utility room. Upstairs you'll find four generous bedrooms, the master with en-suite, and a luxury family bathroom. The property benefits from a beautifully landscaped rear garden, driveway parking for multiple vehicles, and a garage.

properties.description: Modern one bedroom apartment perfect for first-time buyers or investors.
properties.longDescription: This contemporary one bedroom apartment is situated on the third floor of a modern development. The accommodation comprises an open plan kitchen/living area with integrated appliances and access to a private balcony, one double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a stylish bathroom suite. The property benefits from secure entry system, lift access, allocated parking, and is within walking distance of the town centre and train station. Ideal for professionals or as a buy-to-let investment.

properties.description: Luxurious five bedroom executive home with landscaped gardens and double garage.
properties.longDescription: An impressive five bedroom executive detached residence set in a sought-after residential area. This substantial property offers versatile accommodation including entrance hall with gallery landing, two reception rooms, study, luxury kitchen/dining room with bi-fold doors to garden, utility, and ground floor cloakroom. The first floor comprises five bedrooms (master with dressing room and en-suite), family bathroom, and separate WC. Additional features include underfloor heating, smart home technology, landscaped gardens, and a double garage with electric doors.

properties.description: Spacious three bedroom maisonette with private garden and parking.
properties.longDescription: A rarely available three bedroom split-level maisonette forming part of a Victorian conversion. The property offers well-proportioned accommodation over two floors including a bright reception room with feature fireplace, modern fitted kitchen, three good-sized bedrooms, family bathroom, and a separate WC. Benefits include a private rear garden, off-street parking, gas central heating, double glazing, and proximity to local amenities and transport links. Chain free sale.

properties.description: Charming two bedroom cottage with character features and sunny garden.
properties.longDescription: A delightful two bedroom period cottage offering characterful accommodation. The property retains many original features including exposed beams, wooden floors, and an inglenook fireplace. Accommodation comprises entrance porch, cosy living room, dining room, fitted kitchen, two bedrooms, and a bathroom. Outside there is a beautifully maintained cottage garden to the rear with patio area, mature plants and shrubs. Located in a quiet residential area yet within easy reach of local shops and transport.
